annotation_origin: Existing manual polygon labels, converted to tight axis-aligned bounding boxes; no pseudo-labels.
preprocessing: RGB/BGR uint8, stretch to 512x512, no CLAHE or median filter.
similarity_policy: Exclude source IDs already in legacy; exclude added photos with pHash distance <=8 to legacy; group new photos with distance <=8 in the same split.
limitations: Capture-series identifiers are unavailable; visual-similarity grouping cannot guarantee independent views of the same car.
Legacy annotation granularity can differ from source polygons. Original labels are retained unchanged for comparison.
Manual visual review covers a subset; source annotations have not all been independently reannotated.
